confidence_policy: Only individually corroborated metadata and face pairings above .95 with no unresolved issues become Verified. Confidence is judgment, not calibrated probability. OCR/template suggestions are unreliable retrieval aids, never proof.
limitations: Selected 1000 of 2456 prior drafts, excluding both completed second-pass selections (71 and 1000 entries). This group covers 982 non-Soviet ground profiles and 18 Soviet profiles. Candidate-based search across all five supplied photo PDFs, including earlier source positions; not an exhaustive cell-by-cell search for each counter. Twenty-eight selected profiles lack assigned front artwork. Unlocated does not establish absence or a blank reverse. Physical evidence does not resolve metadata interpretation questions. No gameplay validation. Interactive GUI testing remains pending.
final_qa: 42 original/candidate comparison sheets, 31 closer inspection sheets, 22 additional paired QA sheets two revised direct/reciprocal sheets and enlarged native photo panels inspected. Literal names, ratings and mirrored cell/neighbour context were compared; OCR/similarity scores were not evidence. Uncertain Roman-numeral identities, differing engineering symbols, unexpected printed alternates and ambiguous rating formats remain flagged. Coastal defence and headquarters with unsupported or unresolved rating formats remain drafts despite confirmed physical pairings. All front artwork/ratings, shared identification, unknown fields and 5968 outside-selection definitions preserved. Prior physical evidence/issues/notes retained; unsuccessful matching attempts do not erase earlier physical proof.
automated_suite: 49 tests passed; temporary editor save/reload and reverse rendering counts in validation.
